analysis.default_change: never automatic; presented to the user

decision_source: user, 2026-11-10: LED only, two arms, no RAG, no slide-selection evaluation; thresholds, screening-label handling and download scope approved in plan validation
exposure: 19 cohort videos are in the TIB test split and S1 references were exposed through final523; 17 are train and 4 are valid. The cohort is not an unseen set.

extraction.full_environment_capture: phase 2 records every worker_settings value used, per run

limitations: TIB abstracts mostly summarize speech, so ROUGE-L understates any OCR benefit; no_difference is a valid outcome
screening labels were not re-reviewed; mislabelled videos dilute the OCR effect toward no_difference
slide mode has diagnostic-level evidence only; result applies to this configuration (slide, PaddleOCR, 576p)

descriptive: generation time, LED calls, OCR words, slides used
metrics.guard: MiniCheck mean sentence probability, D minus A, evidence = transcript + cleaned OCR for both arms
metrics.primary: ROUGE-L F1 @350 words, D minus A (rouge-score 0.1.2, stemmer on)
metrics.slide_term_coverage: T = content words (>=3 letters, lowercase, stopwords removed) in the cleaned OCR and not in the transcript; coverage = |T ∩ summary words| / |T|; videos with empty T dropped; descriptive only

question: does interleaving slide OCR into the LED input change the English summary versus transcript only

reference.join: dataset field `doi` == cohort id; reference = field `abstract`
reference.note: ASR transcript here is Qwen3-ASR pipeline output, not the TIB transcript used in final523

run_rules.order: A then D within each video

single_changed_factor: LED_INCLUDE_OCR; both arms read the same hashed input file per video

special_cells.error_cell: recorded, pair not comparable, never rerun to change a result
special_cells.ocr_not_in_input: D equals A; still a valid pair (intention-to-treat); report the count
special_cells.segmenter_fell_back_to_content: kept in cohort, flagged, reported separately

supersedes: summary part of plan 261108-1746-ocr-ablation-english-summary (paused, not cancelled)
